layout.arrangement: No main title; three vertical panels side by side filling the slide. Left panel: 'Input Vector: 1-D' header (dark red), scatter plot with regression line on top, Model info box, then Model (Line) equation box. Middle panel: 'Input Vector: 2-D' header (dark red), 3D plane plot on top, Model info box, then Model (Plane) equation box. Right panel: 'Input Vector: d-D' header (green), 'General Case' diagram box on top, Model info box, then Model (Hyperplane) equation box; the entire right panel is enclosed in a tan/brown bordered container. Slide number '7' in a yellow circle at top-right corner.

layout.hierarchy: Three equal columns; colored header banners (red, red, green) dominate the top of each column; plots are the largest elements; equation boxes at bottom use multicolored text (red labels, blue/green equations); the right column is emphasized by the tan container box.

visual_elements.description: 2D scatter plot with regression line: x-axis labeled 'Length', y-axis labeled 'Weight'; ~15 orange/brown dots trending upward; thick black diagonal regression line; magenta dotted vertical and horizontal projection lines from a red point on the line to both axes

3D scatter/fitted-plane plot: axes labeled 'Weight' (vertical), 'Length' (right), 'Radius' (lower-left); a translucent tilted plane with scattered small points above/below it; a red circle with white '?' on the left edge of the plane; two red dots on the plane edges

General Case box: blue header 'General Case'; red text 'Input:' followed by a tall red curly/parenthesis bracket containing vertically stacked x1, x2, x3, ..., ..., xd (red italic subscripted); blue text 'Output: (y)' to the right
Tan/brown rectangular container with dark brown border enclosing the entire right (d-D) column
Yellow circle with dark border containing black number '7' (slide number badge)

imagery: No photos; only the two plots (1-D regression scatter, 2-D plane fit) and the general-case input/output bracket diagram
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Header banners: white bold text on dark red (1-D, 2-D) and green (d-D) rectangles. 'Model' labels in red bold. Equations in blue italic serif-like font with red/green variable coloring (e.g., 'y = a x + b' with a, b in red/green). 'Model Parameters' line in blue italic. Subscripts used for x1...xd and w1...wd+1. 'Input:' red, 'Output: (y)' blue, both bold.
animation_state: Fully built; no partial reveals visible.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F2F2F2). 2. Create three columns. 3. Left column: dark red (#8B0000) banner with white bold text 'Input Vector: 1-D'; below it draw a scatter plot with axes 'Length' (x) and 'Weight' (y), ~15 orange dots, a thick black diagonal regression line, and magenta dotted projection lines to a red point on the line; below add a bordered box with red bold 'Model', then 'I/P: Length [x]' and 'O/P: Weight [y]'; below add equation box: red 'Model ( Line )', blue italic 'y = a x + b' (a,b colored), 'Weight = a * Length + b', and blue italic 'Model Parameters : a , b'. 4. Middle column: red banner 'Input Vector: 2-D'; 3D plot with axes Weight/Length/Radius, a tilted translucent plane with scattered points, a red '?' marker and red dots; model box: 'Model', 'I/P: Length, Radius [x,y]', 'O/P: Weight [z]'; equation box: 'Model ( Plane )', 'z = a x + b y + c', 'Weight = a * Length + b * Radius + c', 'Model Parameters : a , b , c'. 5. Xd]', 'O/P: [Y]'; equation box: 'Model ( Hyperplane )', 'y = w1 x1 + w2 x2 + w3 x3 + ... + wd xd + wd+1' with subscripts, 'Model Parameters : w1 , w2 , , w3 , ...., wd+1'. 6.
